say:1:1630239001:1.text: Meowrrh, finally! I didn't know how badly I wanted someone to notice me until now!
say:1:1630239001:1.source_cn: 喵嗷，太好了！我从未这么想被看见过！
say:1:1630239001:1.male: Meowrrh, finally! I didn't know how badly I wanted someone to notice me until now!
say:1:1630239001:1.female: Meowrrh, finally! I didn't know how badly I wanted someone to notice me until now!

say:2:1630239002:1.text: Life's gotten so unbearably boring. I wreak havoc all day long, and no one even looks my way. No one cares!
say:2:1630239002:1.source_cn: 现在的生活实在是太无聊了！无论我怎么捣乱，都没有人看得...
say:2:1630239002:1.male: Life's gotten so unbearably boring. I wreak havoc all day long, and no one even looks my way. No one cares!
say:2:1630239002:1.female: Life's gotten so unbearably boring. I wreak havoc all day long, and no one even looks my way. No one cares!

say:3:1630239003:1.text: Maybe next time I'll do something really dramatic... see if that gets their attention.
say:3:1630239003:1.source_cn: 也许下次我应该考虑搞点更大的动静……
